name: Hassaku Tsuyuri
source:
Tsuyuri is very fragile and gets sick easily, so she doesn't take part in any clubs. She has anemia and occasionally gets dizzy and lightheaded. She and [url=/c98235]Koyoi[/url] are cousins; she calls Koyoi "Koyo-chan".

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
